description: The FULL 24/7 crypto day-state board: all 81 Robinhood-tradable coins with trend distances (20/50/200-day), multi-timeframe tape lights, ATR%, relative strength vs BTC, room to the 20-day high, volume z-score, mechanical UP/CHOP/DOWN state and cross-sectional ranks, plus the daily BTC/ETH gate and breadth. Publishes about every 5 minutes around the clock when the market moved. A state map, not a ranking. Paid per call via x402. $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_crypto_day_live
